Workflows.title: View checking account activity from the simulator home page
Workflows.goal: Landing page loads with GET STARTED NOW button visible; The simulator dashboard URL loads and welcome dialog appears; Welcome dialog closes and dashboard is fully visible; Both account card headers are visible on the dashboard; Browser navigates to /bank-sim/account?type=checking; Page heading, SELECT ACCOUNT section, Checking/Saving tabs, and transaction table are all visible; Account Opening row is visible in the transaction table
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to the simulator landing page — Landing page loads with GET STARTED NOW button visible
2. Click GET STARTED NOW to enter the simulator — The simulator dashboard URL loads and welcome dialog appears
3. Dismiss the welcome dialog by clicking Ok — Welcome dialog closes and dashboard is fully visible
4. Verify the dashboard shows Checking and Saving account cards — Both account card headers are visible on the dashboard
5. Click VIEW ACCOUNT on the Checking account card — Browser navigates to /bank-sim/account?type=checking
6. Verify the Account Activity page loaded correctly — Page heading, SELECT ACCOUNT section, Checking/Saving tabs, and transaction table are all visible
7. Confirm the seeded Account Opening transaction is present in the table — Account Opening row is visible in the transaction table
